title: Research: carry a dirty connector across a paid source mutation
body:
A persistent dirty connector needs the correction BC*u when its source changes by C*u. The package proves and fully charges this correction, gives a two-call typed composition that removes two B executions, and compares a concrete noncommuting pilot: 43 to 31 XORs and 730 to 558 head steps. Independent engines check all 65,536 matrix quadruples and 32,768 dirty inputs. This remains a partial interface pilot.

Validation: Python 3.12 registered replay with source pins and scoped controls; selected-result integrity or baseline bindings and diff checks pass. See the [reproduction instructions, exact sources and remaining questions](https://github.com/woklerx/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3852c2d03044895cebdc9b31b0c7131a617774d2/research/mutable-source-persistent-connector/README.md). No selected source, certificate or kappa changes; no full selected circuit replay is claimed. Prepared by woklerx with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, with predecessor attribution retained.
